note: Upstream catalog and native adapters are different counting units. No claim of all 42 plays being ported.

plays.title: ILS full-ruin re-place
plays.upstream_description: Unplace everything, re-place with a rotated directive, re-route, keep only strict wins
plays.upstream_trigger: LLM loop stalled ≥ 10 min, or loop exit with budget left

plays.title: ILS partial ruin
plays.upstream_description: Unplace only the worst-200-paths' fabric cells, incremental re-place
plays.upstream_trigger: In rotation; skipped when critical-path spread < 30 tiles

plays.title: ILS last-mile cycle
plays.upstream_description: Netlist-level phys_opt (clock/retime/LUT) + incremental `LastMile` re-place
plays.upstream_trigger: In rotation; only when best WNS ≥ −1.0 ns

plays.title: ILS route re-roll
plays.upstream_description: Unroute + from-scratch `AggressiveExplore` route, nothing else
plays.upstream_trigger: In rotation; near-met only (\|WNS\| ≤ 0.7 ns)

plays.title: ILS route-only re-route
plays.upstream_description: Keep placement, unroute, re-route `AggressiveExplore` + phys_opt
plays.upstream_trigger: In rotation; cheapest cycle, any WNS

plays.title: ILS incremental route escalation
plays.upstream_description: Re-route the *incumbent* routing in place with a stronger directive (no unroute)
plays.upstream_trigger: Appended to rotation; needs an incumbent routed with a weaker directive

plays.title: ILS place-retry ladder
plays.upstream_description: On a cycle-1 regression, force a ladder of untried placement families
plays.upstream_trigger: Cycle regresses vs incumbent; order WNS-keyed

plays.title: Crisis retiming (router R1)
plays.upstream_description: One full-scope `phys_opt -directive AlternateFlowWithRetiming`, then unroute + `AggressiveExplore` re-route
plays.upstream_trigger: ≥ 100k failing endpoints, 7 ≤ \|WNS\| < 10 ns

plays.title: Route-first floor (router R1)
plays.upstream_description: Unroute + `AggressiveExplore` re-route first; retiming only as budget-gated bonus
plays.upstream_trigger: ≥ 100k failing, \|WNS\| ≥ 10 ns (deep-extreme)

plays.title: Placement-preserving sweep (router R2)
plays.upstream_description: Granular post-route phys_opt sweep, `critical_cell_opt` first, placement untouched
plays.upstream_trigger: \|WNS\| ≥ 5 ns, spread ≥ 70 tiles, < 100k failing

plays.title: Class-G re-place (router R3)
plays.upstream_description: Unplace + full re-place (`Explore` or `Auto_1` by spread) + route + retime polish, one shot
plays.upstream_trigger: 1 ≤ \|WNS\| ≤ 5 ns, fmax ratio 35–55%, wall fits

plays.title: Retime sandwich (router R4)
plays.upstream_description: Retime → unplace + re-place (spread-gated directive) → retime again → pin polish
plays.upstream_trigger: 0.5 ≤ \|WNS\| ≤ 2 ns, fmax ratio ≥ 55%

plays.title: Closure ladder (router R7)
plays.upstream_description: Group the worst ~20 endpoints, iterate scoped granular phys_opt; never re-place
plays.upstream_trigger: \|WNS\| < 0.5 ns, fmax ratio ≥ 85% (near-met)

plays.title: Out-of-band safe floor
plays.upstream_description: Route-first (deep) or the R2 sweep (else); full re-place blocked
plays.upstream_trigger: Features match no calibrated rule (hidden designs)

plays.title: Shallow recipe chain
plays.upstream_description: Unroute/unplace → place `WLDrivenBlockPlacement` → phys_opt → route `AggressiveExplore` → phys_opt
plays.upstream_trigger: \|WNS\| ≤ 1.05 ns, pre-LLM slot

plays.title: Deep recipe chain
plays.upstream_description: Pin-swap ×2 → fresh-Vivado round-trip → unplace → place `Explore` → phys_opt → route `AggressiveExplore`
plays.upstream_trigger: \|WNS\| ≥ 8 ns, pre-LLM slot

plays.title: Mid recipe chain
plays.upstream_description: Retime/route/re-place/re-route chain across two Vivado sessions
plays.upstream_trigger: 1.05 < \|WNS\| < 8 ns; needs ~2800 s, fires only on walls well beyond 1 h

plays.title: Own-front retime candidate
plays.upstream_description: Place with the band's proven directive (`ExtraTimingOpt` or `WLDrivenBlockPlacement`) → retime → phys_opt AE → route AE
plays.upstream_trigger: \|WNS\| in [0.90, 1.05]; sub-band picks the chain

plays.title: Shallow determinizer
plays.upstream_description: Place `AltSpreadLogic_medium` → route `Explore` → *incremental* route `AggressiveExplore` → retime polish

plays.title: Sub-band phys_opt floor
plays.upstream_description: Path-group the worst 20 endpoints, then scoped phys_opt ×3, banked in-session
plays.upstream_trigger: \|WNS\| in [0.10, 0.45], ≤ 1000 failing endpoints

plays.title: Deep-replace from pristine
plays.upstream_description: Reopen the *original* input, unplace, full re-place `Explore`, route
plays.upstream_trigger: Deep-extreme band pre-LLM; any design at the tail if budget remains

plays.title: Deep-replace retiming tail
plays.upstream_description: `phys_opt AlternateFlowWithRetiming` on the freshly re-placed design
plays.upstream_trigger: After B1 banks, whenever a ≥ 0.20× slice of the measured place+route cost remains

plays.title: Small-floor sibling
plays.upstream_description: Place `ExtraNetDelay_low` → phys_opt `AggressiveExplore` → route `AggressiveExplore` from pristine
plays.upstream_trigger: Mid band, first stage only; cost ≤ 550 s + physics admission

plays.title: Tail-controller portfolio
plays.upstream_description: Rotate 4 proven moves (re-route, phys_opt ladder, fanout opt, phys_opt AE) by measured ns/s
plays.upstream_trigger: Post-loop, deep-WNS states (best ≤ −1.0 ns)

plays.title: Bare re-route compounding loop
plays.upstream_description: Plain `route_design` iterated while each pass still pays ≥ 0.020 ns
plays.upstream_trigger: Routed banked best + wall fits; deep WNS compounds

plays.title: Mid-band break rung
plays.upstream_description: From the banked best: unroute → `phys_opt -retime` → phys_opt AE → route AE
plays.upstream_trigger: Post-loop, mid band, ~1350 s priced wall

plays.title: Fanout polish
plays.upstream_description: One `phys_opt -directive AggressiveFanoutOpt` pass on the final best
plays.upstream_trigger: Post-ILS; cheap designs only, strict hold floor +0.010 ns

plays.title: Last-mile final polish
plays.upstream_description: The D3 cycle applied once to the *final* plateaued best
plays.upstream_trigger: Post-ILS; best WNS ≥ −1.0 ns, budget fits

plays.title: Winner polish
plays.upstream_description: Up to 4 `phys_opt` passes (default `AggressiveExplore`) on the shipped winner
plays.upstream_trigger: Wrapper wall too short for another attempt (stranded time)

plays.title: Cell re-placement macro
plays.upstream_description: Find cells whose routing detours ≥ 2× Manhattan distance, move them to better sites
plays.upstream_trigger: LLM call; critical paths with movable, detoured cells

plays.title: LUT-cone optimization macro
plays.upstream_description: Merge cascaded small LUTs on the worst paths into fewer, larger LUTs
plays.upstream_trigger: LLM call; LUT-bound critical path

plays.title: Register-retiming macro
plays.upstream_description: `phys_opt` with a retiming directive, re-route, measure
plays.upstream_trigger: LLM call; plateaued designs, near-target Fmax

plays.title: Granular phys_opt sweep macro
plays.upstream_description: Try each phys_opt sub-optimization one at a time, keep wins, revert losses
plays.upstream_trigger: LLM call; budget-tight, or huge designs

plays.title: Scoped phys_opt macro
plays.upstream_description: Path-group the worst N paths, run one phys_opt sub-flag on just that group
plays.upstream_trigger: LLM call; huge designs where global phys_opt is too slow

plays.title: High-fanout replication macro
plays.upstream_description: Surgically replicate the drivers of named high-fanout nets on the worst paths
plays.upstream_trigger: LLM call; fanout-dominated critical paths

plays.title: Manual full re-place (Class G)
plays.upstream_description: Unplace + `place_design` with an escalating directive list + route + retime polish
plays.upstream_trigger: LLM judgment; plateaued/LOSS designs

plays.title: Pblock re-placement (Class C)
plays.upstream_description: Constrain the whole design into a computed compact region, re-place inside it
plays.upstream_trigger: LLM judgment; spread-out designs (avg spread > 70 tiles)

plays.title: Fanout split (Class D manual)
plays.upstream_description: Split one high-fanout net's driver into replicated drivers by factor
plays.upstream_trigger: LLM judgment; a single dominating high-fanout net

plays.title: Surgical phys_opt flags
plays.upstream_description: `-critical_pin_opt` (LUT pin swap), `-clock_opt` (skew), `-force_replication_on_nets`, `-tns_cleanup`
plays.upstream_trigger: LLM judgment; 1–2 stubborn paths after coarser passes

plays.title: Route-directive escalation (Class I)
plays.upstream_description: Re-route with `Explore` → `AggressiveExplore` → `NoTimingRelaxation` / congestion directives
plays.upstream_trigger: LLM judgment; route errors or WNS lost in routing

plays.title: BRAM/DSP relocation (Class F)
plays.upstream_description: Move memory/DSP macros whose path crosses the die via the cell-move play
plays.upstream_trigger: LLM judgment; macro-crossing critical paths

plays.title: ML strategy recommender (Class H)
plays.upstream_description: Run Vivado's `report_qor_suggestions`, apply the suggested directives
plays.upstream_trigger: LLM judgment; unknown/stubborn designs
